recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed; any renewed rendering problem should be handled in the current IG Publisher or the relevant external IG/tooling repository.
issue_request: FHIR-12496 asked that complex extensions generated from spreadsheets render correctly in IG Publisher output, specifically child extension slice names/URLs such as ombCategory and, per comments, bindings in the differential/rendered display.
initial_application: No commit explicitly naming FHIR-12496 was found. The Jira comments say the problem was fixed on 2017-03-02. The same fix window includes FHIR-12907, whose comment points to svn revision 11497; the corresponding git commit f4523b525d1a643dc3583ef0d99f5481f5a3a3e2 added fixed Extension.extension.url values for spreadsheet-defined child slices. Commit 2b4d7452cdcd8c6daaad11be11a81ab538542cc8 addressed binding display in extension summaries.
additional_context: The old US Core spreadsheet implicated by the report is not active in the current core build because source/fhir.ini comments out the us-core profile entry. The historical Java IG Publisher/ProfileUtilities files touched by the 2017 fixes are no longer present in the current checkout, and the FHIR Extension Pack has no current us-core-race/us-core-ethnicity/ombCategory definition to update.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The historical tooling fixes satisfy the issue family, and the affected old spreadsheet/rendering path is outside the current core build scope.
